# Background

This was an individual project in my Linear Algebra course. I took a few weeks to research a application of linear algebra I found interesting and create a corresponding product to present to the professor. I chose to explore Leslie Matrices, objects used in modeling population growth, and create a slideshow presentation. It was a rewarding topic, as it meshes nicely with biology courses I took at the time and since. I also got to learn how to make slides from scratch with Beamer, and presented them to my professor in a short meeting.
